title: PrecurAi Precursor Annotation Record Schema
description: Defensible JSON Schema for annotated unstructured Oil & Gas safety narratives.

report_id.description: Unique identifier for the safety observation or incident report.

report_text.description: Unstructured free-text narrative describing the safety observation, near miss, or incident.

activity.description: Specific operational activity being undertaken (e.g., Crane Lifting, Confined Space Entry, Pipe Welding).

hazard.description: Primary hazard mechanism identified (e.g., Suspended Load, Hydrocarbon Gas Release, High Voltage Electricity).

unsafe_act.description: Extracted human behavior or procedural non-compliance phrase (null if strictly an unsafe condition).

unsafe_condition.description: Extracted physical or environmental hazard state phrase (null if strictly an unsafe act).

potential_consequence.description: Credible worst-case safety consequence based on energy release and barrier failure.

life_saving_rule.description: Applicable IOGP Life-Saving Rule or 'No direct Life-Saving Rule match'.

sif_potential.description: Evaluated SIF precursor potential classification based on high-energy hazard exposure and barrier failure.

evidence.description: Exact text verbatim snippets quoted from report_text supporting the evaluation.

annotator_notes.description: Rationalization and justification written by the HSE annotator.
